name: VRM_SOURCE_DOC_ADDL_SLINES_GT
description: Oracle internal use only. This global temporary table is used in an internal process which validates the additional satisfaction events.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ADDITIONAL_SLINE_ID
columns.description: Unique key generated by the application for an additional subline of a source document.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Unique key generated by the application for a source document line. Examples of source document lines include sales order lines, invoice lines, project lines, and service contract lines.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The source document type code from which the source data is imported.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Source document type identifier of various source applications that integrate with Revenue Management.

columns.name: DOC_ADDITIONAL_SLINE_ID_INT_1
columns.description: First numeric column of the key that identifies the source document additional subline in the source application.

columns.name: DOC_ADDITIONAL_SLINE_ID_INT_2
columns.description: Second numeric column of the key that identifies the source document additional subline in the source application.

columns.name: DOC_ADDITIONAL_SLINE_ID_INT_3
columns.description: Third numeric column of the key that identifies the source document additional subline in the source application.

columns.name: DOC_ADDITIONAL_SLINE_ID_INT_4
columns.description: Fourth numeric column of the key that identifies the source document additional subline in the source application.

columns.name: DOC_ADDITIONAL_SLINE_ID_INT_5
columns.description: Fifth numeric column of the key that identifies the source document additional subline in the source application.

columns.name: DOC_ADDITIONAL_SLINE_ID_CHAR_1
columns.description: First character column of the key that identifies the source document additional subline in the source application.

columns.name: DOC_ADDITIONAL_SLINE_ID_CHAR_2
columns.description: Second character column of the key that identifies the source document additional subline in the source application.

columns.name: DOC_ADDITIONAL_SLINE_ID_CHAR_3
columns.description: Third character column of the key that identifies the source document additional subline in the source application.

columns.name: DOC_ADDITIONAL_SLINE_ID_CHAR_4
columns.description: Fourth character column of the key that identifies the source document additional subline in the source application.

columns.name: DOC_ADDITIONAL_SLINE_ID_CHAR_5
columns.description: Fifth character column of the key that identifies the source document additional subline in the source application.

columns.name: SOURCE_SYSTEM
columns.description: Source application of document data to identify source document sub line. Each integrating application has a unique value, such as EBIZ.

columns.name: DOC_LINE_ID_INT_1
columns.description: First numeric column of the key that identifies source document line in source application.

columns.name: DOC_LINE_ID_INT_2
columns.description: Second numeric column of the key that identifies source document line in source application.

columns.name: DOC_LINE_ID_INT_3
columns.description: Third numeric column of the key that identifies source document line in source application.

columns.name: DOC_LINE_ID_INT_4
columns.description: Fourth numeric column of the key that identifies source document line in source application.

columns.name: DOC_LINE_ID_INT_5
columns.description: Fifth numeric column of the key that identifies source document line in source application.

columns.name: DOC_LINE_ID_CHAR_1
columns.description: First character column of the key that identifies source document line in source application.

columns.description: Second character column of the key that identifies source document line in source application.

columns.name: DOC_LINE_ID_CHAR_3
columns.description: Third character column of the key that identifies source document line in source application.

columns.name: DOC_LINE_ID_CHAR_4

columns.name: DOC_LINE_ID_CHAR_5

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_SE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Additional satisfaction event stamped on the revenue line. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_ADDL_SATIS_EVENTS.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_SE_FULFILLMENT_DATE
columns.description: Fulfillment date of the additional satisfaction event.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_SE_QUANTITY
columns.description: The quantity for which the additional satisfaction event is fulfilled when the satisfaction measurement model is Quantity.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_SE_PERCENT
columns.description: The percentage for which the additional satisfaction event is fulfilled when the satisfaction measurement model is Percentage.

columns.name: AMOUNT_APPLIED
columns.description: Amount of receipt applied to the invoice.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger identifier of source document.

columns.name: DATA_TRANSFORMATION_STATUS
columns.description: This attribute is for oracle Internal use only.

columns.name: ASE_ENTERED_CUR_REVENUE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Fulfillment amount of the additional satisfaction event in the entered currency.

columns.name: ASE_CONT_CUR_ALLOC_REV_AMOUNT
columns.description: Allocated amount equivalent to the fulfillment amount of the additional satisfaction event in the contract currency.

columns.name: ASE_ELIGIBLE_DATE
columns.description: Eligible fulfillment date of the additional satisfaction event.

columns.name: ASE_PROCESS_ORDER
columns.description: Order in which the additional sublines are processed. These lines are processed in the ascending order of the fulfillment dates.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Unique key generated by the application for a source document.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: Indicates the request ID of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: ELIGIBLE_ASE_VALUE
columns.description: Value of the fulfillment of the additional satisfaction event according to the satisfaction measurement model. The value is either the satisfied quantity, satisfied percent, or period equivalent amount.
